feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag ipangakong puwedeng maghintay ang batang hirap huminga. Kailangang agad masuri si Aya.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not promise that a child with breathing difficulty can wait. Aya needs prompt assessment.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi tanging batayan ng referral ang isang lumang bilang. Ang sanay na assessor ang gagamit ng kasalukuyang chart ayon sa edad.
feedback_by_option.en: One old breathing number is not a stand-alone referral rule. A trained assessor uses the current age-specific chart.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Kapag hirap huminga, agad iugnay sa klinikal na pagsusuri sa kumpirmadong daan.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. When breathing is difficult, arrange prompt clinical assessment through the confirmed route.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Iulat ang nakita at ang sagot sa danger signs; ang sanay na assessor ang magpapasya sa iba.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. Report observations and danger-sign answers; the trained assessor decides the rest.

feedback_by_option.fil: Iulat ang nakita nang hindi pumipili ng diagnosis. Ang sanay na assessor ang magpapasya.
feedback_by_option.en: Report observations without choosing a diagnosis. The trained assessor decides.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi tanging batayan ang isang temperatura, at naiiwan pa ang hirap sa paghinga.
feedback_by_option.en: A single temperature is not a stand-alone rule, and it leaves out the breathing difficulty.
